data_plan: Binance Vision public archives (free, keyless), USDT-M futures (futures/um), monthly files, span 2023-10-01..2026-10-31 (37 months) — the programme's verified 15m kline era; data before 2024-07-01 is warm-up / in-sample only under the standard walk-forward folds. Two series per symbol: (1) aggTrades monthly archives — the signal source — staged by streaming aggregation (prints are never held in memory wholesale; a measured in-memory attempt was OOM-killed in the sandbox) into per-bar signed/unsigned base-quantity sums on the kline grid, persisted as bars only, with a per-zip SHA-256 provenance manifest in the pattern of ig/box_theory_provenance.json; (2) klines via the programme's verified loader (data_feed.load_dataset) for prices and ATR. Feasibility was proven BEFORE declaring (2026-11-17 probe): BTCUSDT 2024-01 zip = 522,743,749 bytes, SHA-256 d752f50932091dd209803187ca2354a9eadbfe8e4b9c481c3581a1bbb1bd8282, 40,294,620 prints, full-month bucket coverage (2,976 x 15m); DOGEUSDT 2024-01 zip = 72,993,650 bytes, SHA-256 9dc8e7cf36014bb7ad27f925d4389126029dc2804db605d6faf70d4e9b436d6b, 4,729,271 prints, full-month coverage. The run must state the exact panel, source and date range it used, verify the staged panel against its provenance manifest before simulating, and apply walk-forward folds per programme convention. The run is a separate, later step and is NOT part of the declaring PR.

declared_conventions.kline_1h_hole: The known shared 120-bar hole in the 1h kline archives (manifested by RD-002/RD-012; it touches SOLUSDT, XRPUSDT, LTCUSDT, TRXUSDT of this universe) is handled as the programme has always handled it: the series is used exactly as archived; a flow window containing a missing bar is incomplete and produces no signal; a position open across a gap is exit-checked on the next existing bar, with gap fills at that bar's open per the execution convention.
declared_conventions.missing_data: Gaps are reported, never filled (programme hard rule). A symbol with any missing or unparseable monthly archive inside the span, or any symbol-month whose aggregated bucket coverage does not match its kline bars, is EXCLUDED from the panel entirely and named in the run's coverage manifest. If fewer than 8 of the 10 symbols survive, the run is UNTESTABLE and does not proceed.
declared_conventions.position_sizing: Sizing is not part of this family's backtest identity — the bar judges per-trade expectancy / profit factor, which are sizing-invariant. If a cell ever reaches forward testing it inherits the fleet-standard decided risk package (FWD-006) unchanged, as with SRS and S-RD1.
declared_conventions.quantity_basis: Imbalance is computed on base-asset quantity exactly as archived in the aggTrades 'quantity' field, not quote (USDT) volume. Within one symbol and window this is the archived, reproducible choice; switching basis would be a variant.
declared_conventions.sign_convention: is_buyer_maker=false means the buyer was the TAKER (aggressive buy, +); is_buyer_maker=true means the buyer was the maker and the taker was the seller (aggressive sell, -). Stated explicitly because the field's name invites the opposite reading; the harness's synthetic tests pin this convention.
declared_conventions.streaming_only: Staging must aggregate the archives streaming, month by month, and persist only the aggregated bars plus the provenance manifest. Holding a full symbol-month of prints in memory is prohibited by measurement, not preference (sandbox OOM on a single BTC month).
declared_conventions.universe_reduction: The census slate proposed crypto30; the full panel was measured to be impractical to stage in this sandbox (BTCUSDT alone is ~523 MB zipped / 40.3M prints per month, ~19 GB over the span; the full 30-symbol panel is honestly estimated at ~45-75 GB of archives and ~2-3B prints against 85 GB of free disk). The universe is therefore reduced UP FRONT — before any results exist — to the 10 named majors with continuous USDT-M futures listings predating the span and the deepest print flow. This is a scope limit of v1, stated here so it can never be mistaken for post-hoc selection: the 10 names were fixed by listing age and flow depth, not by any performance information (none exists for this data class). A crypto30 leg would require its own declaration.
declared_conventions.wf_select: None. Each mechanism carries exactly one frozen parameter set, so there is nothing to select in-sample; no wf-select procedures are declared and none may be reported under this declaration.

evaluation_bar.costs: programme cost model AND a 2x-cost shadow run, both must pass: crypto 16 bps round trip (Binance USDT-M taker 5 bps/side + 3 bps/side spread+slippage, rd2/costs2.py CRYPTO); 2x shadow = 32 bps round trip
evaluation_bar.deletion_rule: Owner rule: a cell whose strict OOS profit factor is < 1.2 is deleted completely (family closed for that cell); a full-bar pass is required before anything is wired anywhere.
evaluation_bar.holdout: rd.common.holdout_check must pass (per cell, pooled over the universe)
evaluation_bar.insufficient_data: A cell with fewer than 200 OOS trades reports exactly 'insufficient OOS trades' — it is neither a pass nor evidence about the mechanism.
evaluation_bar.judgement: OOS only (walk-forward folds W1-W5, OOS era 2024-07-01 -> 2026-11-01, trades attributed by entry time); parameters are frozen by this declaration — nothing is selected in-sample
evaluation_bar.multiple_testing: Bonferroni one-sided p < 0.05 / N against the programme trial floor at run time. Programme counter at declaration = 3,891 declared trials (discovery census, 2026-11-17). Queued ahead of this family: SRS (1 cell) and S-RD1 (1 cell). This declaration adds exactly 4 trials; if both queued runs land first, the floor at this family's judgement is 3,897 and alpha ~= 1.283e-05. The run must state the floor it used.

hypothesis: Aggressive (taker) order flow imbalance, measured from the actual trade prints rather than inferred from candles, carries short-horizon information that OHLCV proxies destroy: (a) flow_thrust — a sustained extreme imbalance over a 4-hour window (net taker buying or selling dominating total printed volume) continues in the imbalance's direction often enough to clear the bar with a 2.0/3.0 ATR bracket; (b) flow_absorption — when price prints a fresh 5-hour extreme AGAINST the window's net flow (new high on net taker selling, new low on net taker buying), the flow is absorbing the move and the extreme mean-reverts often enough to clear the bar with a 1.5/2.0 ATR bracket and a short max hold.
promotion_path: Passing the full bar in a cell makes that cell a forward-test CANDIDATE only, under the Phase-3 forward protocol (>= 100 trades AND >= 8 weeks on demo). Nothing here authorises live trading.

rules.aggregation: Bars sit on the same UTC grid as the Binance Vision klines of the cell's timeframe. An aggTrade belongs to bar t iff t <= transact_time < t + timeframe (transact_time in milliseconds). Per bar: qty = sum of the prints' base-asset quantity; delta = sum of signed quantity, where a print's sign is +quantity if is_buyer_maker is false (the taker was the buyer) and -quantity if is_buyer_maker is true (the buyer was the maker, so the taker was the seller).
rules.atr: Wilder ATR(14) on the klines of the cell's timeframe, causal (bars up to and including the signal bar). All bracket distances use the ATR of the signal bar.
rules.cells: Exactly 4 cells: {flow_thrust, flow_absorption} x {15m, 1h}, each pooled over the frozen 10-symbol universe. This declaration adds exactly 4 trials to the programme counter.
rules.execution: Programme harness convention (rd.fastsim): signal on the close of bar t -> enter at the open of bar t+1; the entry bar is exit-checked; within a bar the stop is checked before the target (worst case); a gap through a level fills at the bar open; one position at a time per symbol; warmup 260 bars before any signal.
rules.flow_absorption_entry: State form, evaluated on the close of bar t when flat, with n = 20 bars at 15m and 5 bars at 1h (a 5-hour lookback): LONG iff low(t) < min(low of bars t-n..t-1) AND CI_L(t) > 0; SHORT iff high(t) > max(high of bars t-n..t-1) AND CI_L(t) < 0. Entry at the open of bar t+1.
rules.flow_absorption_exit: Bracket from the entry price: stop at 1.5 x ATR, target at 2.0 x ATR (signal-bar ATR), with a max hold of 24 bars at 15m / 12 bars at 1h — if neither level is hit first, exit at the close of the max-hold-th bar counting the entry bar as bar 1 (levels are still checked before the time exit within that bar).
rules.flow_imbalance: CI_L(t) = (sum of delta over the L bars ending at t) / (sum of qty over the same bars), with L = 16 bars at 15m and 4 bars at 1h (a 4-hour window at both timeframes). CI_L(t) is UNDEFINED — and bar t produces no signal — if any bar of the window is missing from the series or the window's total qty is 0.
rules.flow_thrust_entry: State form, evaluated on the close of bar t when flat: LONG iff CI_L(t) >= +0.25; SHORT iff CI_L(t) <= -0.25. Entry at the open of bar t+1.
rules.flow_thrust_exit: Bracket from the entry price: stop at 2.0 x ATR, target at 3.0 x ATR (signal-bar ATR). No time stop; a position still open at the end of the series exits at the final bar's close (END_OF_DATA).
rules.no_lookahead: A signal at bar t uses only prints inside bars <= t and klines <= t; aggregation is by construction confined to each print's own bar; no partial (still-forming) bar is ever read.
rules.parameters_fixed: THETA=0.25, FLOW_WINDOW=4h (L=16 bars @15m / 4 @1h), EXTREME_LOOKBACK=5h (n=20 @15m / 5 @1h), ATR_PERIOD=14, THRUST_SL=2.0, THRUST_TP=3.0, ABS_SL=1.5, ABS_TP=2.0, ABS_MAX_HOLD=24 bars @15m / 12 @1h, WARMUP=260 bars — no other variants are authorised under this declaration; trying variants means new declarations and a higher trial count.
rules.universe: Exactly 10 symbols, frozen by name: BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT, BNBUSDT, SOLUSDT, XRPUSDT, DOGEUSDT, ADAUSDT, TRXUSDT, LTCUSDT, LINKUSDT (see declared_conventions.universe_reduction). Adding or removing a symbol is a new declaration.

source: FRIDAY Universe strategy-discovery census, 2026-11-17 (str-discovery-census/CENSUS.md), recommended slate item #1: true order flow from trade prints (aggTrades CVD / trade-flow imbalance / aggressive-flow absorption). Coverage boundary, stated exactly: RD-012 (Stratex/rigorous_backtest/RESULTS_RD12.md) judged order-flow PROXY families built from OHLCV only — its own record says 'No L2 / trade-level data exists in this programme, so every flow quantity is an OHLCV-derived proxy, declared as such — nothing here is true delta'. All 28 RD-012 trials failed (best PF 0.9952), but that verdict covers the proxies (CLV, sign(close-open) x volume, CLV-weighted volume on klines), NOT trade prints: no round in the programme has ever loaded an aggTrade. This declaration is the first true-print trial; RD-012's failure neither passes nor condemns it.
status: DECLARED — not yet run. No backtest of this family has been executed anywhere at declaration time, and none is executed in the declaring PR. The data-feasibility probe (two symbol-months downloaded and parsed to verify the source) produced no signal, no trades and no performance numbers.
